typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS MEMBERNUMBER,PCT.CODE_DT FROM PDS_OB_POST_CALLLIST_TERMINATION PCT 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON PCT.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_IID AND PCT.SENT_TO_WARMHEALTH = 0  AND PCT.SOURCE_CALLLIST_CD = \'497\' 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN dbo.PDS_RPT_UNITJOB RU ON RU.UNITJOB_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_UNITJOB_IID 	INNER JOIN dbo.PDS_WARMHEALTH_UNITJOBS PWU ON PWU.WARMHEALTH_UNITJOB_NAME = RU.UNITJOB_NAME AND PWU.WARMHEALTH_TWILL_UNITJOB_IND = 1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		FIRST_TERM_CODE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBERNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FIRST_TERM_CODE_DATE = CODE_DT,
		MEMBERNUMBER)) ~> FlatFileDestination497
